Hi Sam —

Thanks again for sharing the redline. I uploaded a clean copy and a quick annotated pass (attached) — we took a look and have a couple of clarifying items for the MSA and the onboarding timeline. To keep this simple, can we do a 30-minute redline walk + onboarding check before you finalize procurement?

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 17 Apr, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 17 Apr, 14:00–14:30
- Thu 18 Apr, 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, send times that do and we’ll adapt. Rishi (legal) and Stephanie (sales ops) are cc’d to cover contract points and onboarding handoff.

Attachments: MSA_redline_v3.pdf (annotated), agenda-msaredline-orbit-20280417.pdf

Thanks,
